solutions.title: Repeated pair removal
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly delete adjacent valid pairs until no more pairs can be removed.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each removal pass scans the string and may remove only a small number of pairs.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Each replacement creates intermediate strings proportional to the current length.

solutions.title: Opening bracket stack
solutions.strategy: Push opening brackets and require each closer to match the most recent opener.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every character is pushed, popped, or checked once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: In the worst case all characters are opening brackets and remain on the stack.
